In this document, I'm going to evaluate the Tumor growth of mice treated with Immunocheckpoint blockers and chemoimmunotherapy.

## First, lets plot the data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| dev: png
#accessing the archive folder
setwd("C:/Users/luisr/Documentos/Documents/Documentos - Copia/Mestrado/Tumor Growth/Tumor-growth-master-s-dissertation")

library(tidyverse)
library(magick)

tumorData <- read.csv("TumorGrowthctm.csv")

ggplot(
  tumorData,
  aes(day, volume, color = group)
) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = volume-std, ymax = volume+std
    ),
    width = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor progression",
    y = "Volume(mm³)",
    X = "Day after graft"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  ) 
```
